metadata.title: CodePath Academy — Become a Developer by Building
metadata.description: Learn Foundation, Frontend, and Backend development by building real projects step by step. Start free.

footer.tagline: Start from zero. Build real things. Become a developer.

hero.subtitle: CodePath Academy takes you from “I have never written code” to shipping real websites and applications — one growing project at a time, through Foundation, Frontend, and Backend.
